Position Overview: 

KPMG is seeking an Assistant Manager for the Advisory Digital Project, Risk, and Compliance team. This role supports the Technology Risk Review (TRR) process to help ensure technology solutions align with firm policies, risk standards, and compliance requirements. The individual in this role will manage TRRs for assigned solutions, coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders, and help drive timely, well-documented review outcomes. 

This role requires strong project management, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills. The Assistant Manager will work closely with Advisory, Risk Management, Office of General Counsel, Security, Privacy, Procurement, and other stakeholders to support efficient review execution.

new.title: Analyst
new.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Claims Reporting Consultant / Specialist to join our Claims function on a contract basis. We have a mature claims reporting suite — 40+ Power BI reports in production for over a year — and now need a senior individual who can extend its analytical and insight capability.
